name: Scarlet Monastery: Fairbanks' area Sleep takes only the damage dealer
contract: High Inquisitor Fairbanks 4542 is a Scarlet Monastery (map 189, expansion 0) encounter boss. His Ascension kit
casts Sleep 8399 on himself (event 9002, target self, first after 25-27 s, then every 25-27 s): Spell.dbc targets
SRC_CASTER / SRC_AREA_ENEMY with radius index 8, so it sleeps every enemy within 5 yd of him. Vanilla dungeon
boss sleeps never reach a tank or healer specialization (BossControlTargeting.h): the area targets drop them, and
a sleep aimed at the boss himself starts only while a player who is neither is engaged. Every player gets Immune
Poly/Fear/ 28237 (mechanic immunity to polymorph, fear and root, not sleep), so his kit Fear 12096 cannot move
anyone out of the 5 yd radius. The fight is at the Cathedral entrance (areatrigger_teleport 610). The players are
level 40 humans, matching the boss. They group in Stormwind and teleport into one instance, where Fairbanks is
summoned 2 yd away at his own stats; player health fixtures keep everyone alive through the window. Vanguard 21
tanks, Grovekeeper 58 heals and Boltslinger 10 deals damage, all inside the radius: the sleep must land on the
damage dealer and never on the tank or healer standing beside them.
